capabilities: Search files by heading text instead of filename
Navigate to symbols (headings, tags, links, embeds, callouts) in any file
Switch between open editors and side-panel views
Run commands and switch workspaces or vaults from the switcher
List related items such as backlinks, outgoing links, and same-folder files
extras: README states it has only been tested on MacOS and that opening vaults from the switcher is an experimental feature; author requests donations.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian.md plugin that extends the functionality of the builtin "Quick Switcher".
problem: The built-in Quick Switcher only searches filenames, so finding a note by its headings, jumping to a symbol, or switching between open editors requires separate tools.

relations.evidence: extends the functionality of the builtin "Quick Switcher"
the core Obsidian "Command Palette" plugin must remain enabled

requires.name: core Bookmarks, Workspaces, and Command Palette

summary: Enhanced switcher that extends the core Quick Switcher with heading search, symbol navigation, editor switching, workspaces, bookmarks, commands, and related-item modes.
